tex_content.html:
Every immersed $C^2$ loop at time $t_0$ has an immersed curve-shrinking flow on $[t_0,t_1')$ for some $t_1'>t_0$. The solution extends through $t_1'$ as immersions unless $\max _{S^1}k(\cdot ,t)\to \infty $ as $t\uparrow t_1'$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch This is the standard short-time existence and continuation criterion, Theorem 1.13 of \cite{AG}.

□

Lemma
[Area bound for embedded curve-shrinking flow]
